sequences.text: Gold is dēorwierðre ðonne seolfor.
Rihtwīsnes is dēorwierðre ðonne gold.
Ðæt bæð is hāt.
Ðā baðu sindon hāt.
Ðā dēor sindon cwicu.
Suma męregrēotan sindon blaca.
Ðæt īgland is fæger.
Męreswīn swimmað þurh ðæt wæter.
Hēr sindon fiscas oft fangen.
Sēo niht is fægerre ðonne se dæg.
Sēo ceaster wæs geweorðod mid weallum and gatum.

sequences.text: Sumer cymð, and ðonne cymð winter.
Sēo sunne scīnð ofer eall.
Se ealda mann cōm tō ðǣm hūse.
Hēr sindon ēac lēad and īsern funden.
Ne dō ðīne hand on ðæt fȳr.
Se cęmpa nimð ðone gimm.
Se regn scęðeð ðǣm torre.
Se hwæl swimð.
Fisceras fēngon sēolas.
Ðā hungrigan scēap ne sindon fēded.
Ðæs mannes wīf is fæger.
Sume męnn sindon blace.
Se trēowwyrhta scrȳt his sunu.
Gewīt fram mē, for-ðon-ðe ic eom synfull mann, Dryhten.
Hīe drincað, ac gē bēoð ðurstige.
Hē sægde hiere: Sęle mē, ic bidde ðē, wæter drincan; for-ðon-ðe ic eom ðurstig.
Hē nis God dēadra, ac cwicra.
Sēo sunne scīnð ofer ðā rihtwīsan and ðā unrihtwīsan.
Gē sindon ðǣre worulde lēoht.
Ðā twęlf gatu wǣron twęlf męregrēotan.
Ðǣre ceastre strǣt wæs gold.
Ðā ðe ǣton wǣron fēower ðūsend manna, būtan wīfum and bearnum.
